title: Terrain / continuous sculpting
iteration: 2026-10-08 / cached brush updates and compact strokes
goal: Hold the terrain brush to build up a surface or draw a freehand ridge continuously. F1 opens the four terrain tools; Ctrl+S saves the finished stroke.
changes: The earlier sampled-field cache is restored. Repeated brush doses share one footprint, untouched columns reuse their meshes, and cursor motion keeps accumulating while the worker rebuilds. Each held stroke is one undo step. Save waits for the last queued samples. Equivalent additive strokes are consolidated without merging across tunnels or grenade cuts. Cold first touches and large edits can still take longer.
controls: F1 opens/closes terrain tools. Raise/Lower: hold LMB on ground. Tunnel: click entrance then exit; Alt-click targets a far surface; Esc cancels. Mountain fill: click once. In the editor hold RMB + WASD to fly, Space/Ctrl vertical, Shift faster; wheel zooms and Shift-wheel changes radius. Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo. Outside the editor: B grenade, WASD drive, Space brake, C camera, E fly/drive, R recover, F5 vehicle setup, F2 briefing, F8 jitter capture.
